statements.status_notes: CVE-2010-4651: GNU patch 2.6.1 and earlier would create or overwrite files outside the working tree when a patch named a destination with an absolute path or a '..' component. GNU patch 2.7 fixed this by ignoring such destination file names; the 2.7 entry in the upstream NEWS file states that the change addresses CVE-2010-4651 (https://sources.debian.org/src/patch/2.8-2/NEWS/). This package is built from upstream patch 2.8, where the check is filename_is_safe() in src/util.c, consulted through name_is_valid() in src/pch.c when the file to patch is chosen (https://sources.debian.org/src/patch/2.8-2/src/util.c/, https://sources.debian.org/src/patch/2.8-2/src/pch.c/). Every published build of this package is based on 2.8 and contains the fix; the range boundary is the currently published package version. Debian's tracker rates the issue unimportant and records no fixed version (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2010-4651).
